name: everything-exam-preparation
description: A manifest-driven, single-pass exam-preparation system for course Notes, question-based Practice, and Essay support.

interface.shortDescription: Create course Notes, exam Practice, and Essay support in one pass.
interface.longDescription: Routes explicit student requests to knowledge-only Notes, question-based Practice, or Essay support using trusted material, one-pass generation, and bounded checks.
defaultPrompt: Create course Notes from these lectures and use the past papers to calibrate emphasis.
Prepare worked solutions and organise these exam questions.
Build an essay plan and match reliable Extra Reading to its claims.
